

## Source

*The Daily News-Journal*, Murfreesboro, Tennessee, Saturday, March 04, 1933, page 3


## Transcription


**Birth announcement**

Mr. and Mrs. Claude Gattis are receiving congratulations on the arrival of a daughter at Rutherford Hospital on Thursday.
